test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1st December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Seven people, Gaurav, Manish, Rahul, Anish, Meeta, Priya, and Preeti, are sitting in a circle. Gaurav is the neighbour of Manish and Rahul. Anish is not the neighbour of Meeta and Rahul. Preeti is the neighbour of Meeta and Priya and sitting second to the left of Anish. What is the position of Rahul?

options.text: Fourth to the right of Priya
Second to the right of Anish

solution:
Seven people, **Gaurav, Manish, Rahul, Anish, Meeta, Priya, and Preeti**, are sitting in a circle. 

1. Preeti is the neighbour of Meeta and Priya and sitting second to the left of Anish.

**Case I:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2aedad0abfaa2dc4d0358c96cfbd0b84483c6a239a435c114cbacd115f374c63.png] 

**Case II:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31fbf881c5664fa1669de5b294790f44b2e38189eab96d376cb24992937a1180.png] 

2. Anish is not the neighbour of Meeta and Rahul.

(According to this Case 1 is eliminated because in case 1 Anish is the neighbour of meeta)

Case II:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31fbf881c5664fa1669de5b294790f44b2e38189eab96d376cb24992937a1180.png] 

3. Gaurav is the neighbour of Manish and Rahul. 

Case II:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3005d1d3d09024d1f977d55beb9ab5446b2afd8d075840b1cc12e29f4faebc92.png] 

 
• **Fourth to the right of Priya → Rahul is fourth to the right of Priya.**
 
• Second to the right of Anish → Gaurav is second to the right of Anish.
 
• Between Manish and Gaurav → No one is between Manish and Gaurav.
 
• Immediate left to Preeti → Priya is to the immediate left to Preeti.

Clearly, the position of Rahul is fourth to the right of Priya.

Hence, '**Fourth to the right of Priya**' is the correct answer.
